notes: Cataclysm 1.0 LITE MOBILE: real hand-painted 2D game art, white cat, coral scarf, two pistols, expressive eyes. Textured fur, cloth, metal and painted shading; never vector polygons or stitched limbs. Drawn key poses with contact/down/passing/up for run, distinct attack anticipation/recoil/recovery, idle, hit, red-eye feral and adrenaline. Sharp silhouettes at phone size. Keep version 1.0, gameplay, allies, enemies, maps, UI and audio unchanged. No runtime procedural skeleton; baked 96px PNG frames only.
